cause: The main workflow constructs the shipment request with reservation_id set to input.order_id instead of the reservation_id returned by inventory/reserve. The subsequent check compares shipping's reservation_id with the returned reservation's reservation_id, so it fails with reservation-routing-mismatch rather than producing the required shipment value.
evidence: The execution_errors record for workflow-evaluation-1 reports reason explicit_failure and kind workflow_failed; its complete boundary_failure relationship leads to an activity item showing the evaluation stopped with status error.
The explicit_failure_values record at sequence 9 contains {kind: reservation-routing-mismatch}.

The captured prelude source for component main defines shipment-source to emit (shipping/schedule {reservation_id (get input order_id), ...}) and run then fails unless shipment.reservation_id equals reservation.reservation_id.
